text:
sam: Morning — accepted the GitHub invite but can't see any private repos. I have a personal GH account (sam.codes@gmail.com) and my work email (sam@redwood.ai). Which one should I be using? I also got a 2FA prompt and I'm not sure which device it went to. :confused:

maria: Hey! Use your work email account for org membership if possible. If you accidentally accepted with your personal account you'll need to either switch or we can resend. Do you see the org in your profile (https://github.com/orgs/redwood-inference)?

sam: I can see the org listed under personal account but no team repos. If I go to any repo URL I get a 404. I ran `gh auth status` and it shows: 
```bash
authenticated to github.com as sam.codes (GitHub.com)
``` 
So it looks like GH CLI is logged into personal.

jake: If GH CLI is pointing at personal that's why. Quick options: (1) create new account with work email and accept invite, (2) change the org invite to your personal email (not recommended), (3) we can remove the personal membership and re-invite your work account. Also remember to authorize SSO via Settings -> Applications -> Authorized OAuth Apps -> "Redwood SSO" if prompted.

maria: To add SSH keys: run `ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "sam@redwood.ai"` then `pbcopy < ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub` and paste at https://github.com/settings/keys. But first fix the account mismatch.

linda-people-ops: pinging @sam — we can resend the invite to sam@redwood.ai. If you accepted with personal we can remove that membership. DM me the personal GH username and I'll coordinate with infra to re-invite. :wave:

devex-bot: Docs: Onboarding -> GitHub access: https://redwood.devex/docs/onboarding/github (includes SSO/2FA steps and team mapping). Recommended flow: accept invite with work account -> enable 2FA (authenticator app or YubiKey) -> authorize org SSO.

sam: Thanks — I'll DM @linda-people-ops my personal username. Also I'll generate the SSH key and add work account if you re-send. One more Q: will my GH email need to be a company email or is alias fine? :thinking:

maria: Work email preferred for repo history and CLA checks. Alias usually ok if it's verified and belongs to your employer domain, but people-ops can confirm. You'll get a follow-up when invite is re-sent.

sam: great, thanks everyone :thumbsup:
